**Fabricated ref name caused three #701 defects; ref:null collapsed refResolved**

**What**: `resolveUpstreamRef` returned the literal string `'origin/main'` from the line reached only when EVERY candidate ref failed. Changed to `ref: null`, making `ref == null` the discriminator. That deleted the `refResolved` field from all three carry sites (`lib/upstream-records.mjs`, `staged-records-check.mjs`, `backends/engram.mjs`) and removed the `{ref}` slot from `memory.share.upstreamUnavailable`.

**Why**: One fabricated string caused three separate operator-visible defects: (1) "the upstream base was derived as origin/main instead" printed on a run where nothing was derived; (2) `refResolved` existed ONLY to disambiguate an ambiguity the fabrication created; (3) `upstreamUnavailable` interpolated the invention one line under a line saying nothing resolved.

**Where**: brain/scripts/memory/lib/upstream-records.mjs, staged-records-check.mjs, backends/engram.mjs, cli.mjs, i18n/en.mjs, i18n/es.mjs, openspec/changes/issue-701-memory-export-scope/design.md. Branch fix/issue-701-cold-review-round-2 in worktree brain-issue-701-r2.

**Learned**:
- The `ref:null` collapse WORKED and deleted `refResolved` entirely (13 exec production lines added, 14 removed — net -1).
- The catalog key pair (`configUnreadable` / `configUnreadableNoRef`) was NOT collapsed, deliberately. Collapsing needs either a message naming a ref when none answered (the original defect) or naming none at all — and in 4 of the 5 reachable shapes where the config is unreadable AND a derived ref answered, no other printed line names that ref (`dedupedUpstream` only prints on a non-zero count; the gate's refusal message names no ref).
- When a wrapper drops a `{ref}` slot, the ref must move into the string built where truth is known: the three `ls-tree` failure arms now name the ref they ran against.
- Two ambient-input traps in this repo's tests: `t()` resolves `docs.language` from `brain.config.json` at the MODULE's location (`lib/brain-config.mjs`), so hard-coded English prose assertions are assertions about the maintainer's checkout — flipping to `"es"` reddened 5 tests and made every `doesNotMatch` vacuous. Fix: resolve expectations through the catalog in the AMBIENT locale (the process under test reads the same file) and compare as exact substrings.
- `import { t }` collides with node:test's TestContext param `t`. Alias it (`t as msg`).
- Deleting a top-level `execFileSync('sh',['-c','command -v which'])` is necessary but NOT sufficient: `probeBinary` spawns `which engram`, so on an image with no `which` the file goes 3 pass / 5 fail instead of aborting at import. A one-line `which` stub in the test's `bin` dir closes it (8/8 with `which` stripped from PATH).
- MUTATION DISCIPLINE COST WORK AGAIN: `git checkout -- <path>` after a mutation discarded an UNCOMMITTED source edit in the same file. Commit before mutating, every time.
